description: One record per Snapchat Spotlight link, with its direct video URL, caption, creator info, engagement counts and optional AI metadata, transcript and comments.

attachmentUrl.description: Attachment URL linked from the snap (sparse)

audioTranscriptionObjectUrl.description: URL to audio transcription object (when available)

contextCards.description: Context card objects linked to the snap (when include_ai_metadata=true)

detectedLanguages.description: Detected language scores [{languageCode, score}] from cuSignals (when include_ai_metadata=true)

error.description: Error message if scraping failed for this URL

hasAttachment.description: Whether this snap has an attachment

hashtags.description: Hashtags associated with the snap (when include_ai_metadata=true)

inputUrl.description: Original input URL supplied by the user

intervalStartTimeMs.description: Snap interval start time in milliseconds (when present)

isAttributed.description: Whether the snap is attributed to a creator

isSponsored.description: Whether this snap is sponsored content

relatedStories.description: Related spotlight story summaries with thumbnailUrl, storyPageUrl, durationSeconds, creatorUsername

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was scraped

snapSubtitles.description: Subtitle/caption data embedded in the snap (when present)

transcript.description: Parsed WebVTT transcript segments [{startTime, endTime, text}] (when includeTranscript=true)

transcriptUrl.description: URL to original WebVTT transcript file (when transcript is available)

viewCount.description: Total view count (from engagementStats or videoMetadata)

results.description: Dataset containing scraped Spotlight video records

title: Snapchat Spotlight Video Link & Caption Downloader Output
